From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Sep 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OnyxCloud vendor packet — insurance attestation and PO steps

Nicole —

Appreciate the packet. Quick answers up front so you can proceed:

1) Certificate holder vs. additional insured: we do not require Redwood to be listed as certificate holder. We require Redwood Inference, Inc. to be listed as Additional Insured on the General Liability and Auto policies, and the policy endorsement to state that Additional Insured status is primary and non-contributory for obligations arising under the contract.

2) Name/Address: please use full legal name "Redwood Inference, Inc." and our corporate address in the endorsement: 125 Harbor Drive, San Francisco, CA 94105. Claims contact on the certificate is optional but helpful — if present list legal@redwood.com.

3) Waiver of subrogation: preferred on the General Liability and Workers' Compensation where your insurer allows it. If not available, note limitation in the declaration.

4) Subcontractor coverage: we ask for either the endorsement that extends Additional Insured status to vendors' subcontractors, or a list of named subcontractors on file. If you expect to use third parties, please include subcontractor declarations.

5) W-9 / vendor name: AP needs the exact legal name and EIN as it appears on the W-9 PDF. If the W-9 shows a 'doing business as' name, include the legal entity line as well.

For timing, Marissa (cc'd) manages PO staging. Vanessa — can you confirm whether procurement can accept a conditional PO while endorsements are pending (we do this for small contract values with an ETA for endorsement within 30 days)?

If it's helpful we can accept the intake form via your portal; please mark the insurance files as "evidence pending endorsement" if you're going to upload now.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Nicole / Ben —

Thanks for the details. Ben, we can proceed with a conditional PO for the initial quarterly order up to $40k, provided the following is logged in our intake tracker:
- Certificate uploaded to vendor portal with a clear note "endorsement pending"
- Expected endorsement delivery date (max 30 days)
- AP contact for invoicing (name + email) and remit address

Nicole — for Redwood standard acceptance please request the following from your insurer:
- Additional Insured Endorsement (CG 2010 or equivalent) adding "Redwood Inference, Inc."
- Primary & Non-Contributory language on both GL and Auto
- Waiver of Subrogation on WC if available

If you anticipate any delay, please flag the vendor record so we can queue a secondary review. I'll create the PO stub and route to AP once the intake is uploaded.

Marissa Cole
